_comment: MANUAL ONE-TIME STEP. Create this policy by hand (console or CLI with your own admin credentials) BEFORE running any Phase 0-2 automation. Name it exactly 'PlatformBootstrapBoundary' so the Condition in platform-bootstrap-policy.json resolves correctly. This is the ceiling: any role the automated bootstrap policy creates is capped at whatever this boundary allows, no matter what policy gets attached to that role later.
